## ctxloom fragment delete

Delete a fragment

### Synopsis

Delete a fragment from a bundle.

Reference format: bundle#fragments/name

Examples:
  ctxloom fragment delete my-bundle#fragments/old-standard

```
ctxloom fragment delete <bundle>#fragments/<name> [flags]
```
